sentence: In 1952, a trade-industry update added alexandrite to June, citrine to November, pink tourmaline to October, and zircon to December (sources disagree on whether that specific revision was carried out by Jewelers of America's predecessor or a separate body, the Jewelry Industry Council of America, the same unresolved attribution this calendar noted on [December's birthstone page](/december-birthstone/)).
